🌾 Hello everyone! I've created a high-definition body type mod. A huge thank you to @葡萄干 (Grape) for their assistance and participation づ♡ど.

🍇 【Mod Description】
· This is an HD body type mod. It currently includes most basic animations, and special animations will be updated continuously.
· It is currently in the beta testing phase. If you encounter any bugs, please report them, and I will fix them.
· Requirements:

1. Fashion Sense (Nexus ID: 9969)
2. Emperor's Clothes (Nexus ID: 36971)
  · Crucial Setup: In the Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) in-game, find "Emperor's Clothes" and enable the "Transparent Body" option.

💐 【How to Use】
The body type is divided into two parts. Open the FS Hand Mirror in-game to equip them:
· Body Part: Search for hetao under the Accessory category.
· Arms Part: Search for hetao under the Sleeves category.

📜 【Permissions & Credits】
· 🚫 No Edits or Re-uploads: You are strictly prohibited from modifying (editing) any images of this body type, as well as reselling or re-uploading it.
· ✅ Derivative Clothing is Welcome: You are allowed to use this body type as a base to draw and release clothing, pants, hats, or accessories! (No extra permission needed for clothing mods).
